lessons.title: Menene Mobile App Development?
lessons.summary: Ma'anar gina apps na wayar hannu
lessons.content:
Mobile App Development shine aikin gina software da ke gudana a wayar hannu ko tablet, kamar apps na WhatsApp, Facebook, ko bankin dijital. Wadannan apps sun bambanta da shafukan yanar gizo na yau da kullum domin galibi ana sauke su daga shago kamar Google Play Store ko Apple App Store, sannan su gudana kai tsaye a na'urar mai amfani.

Apps na wayar hannu suna da damar amfani da fasalolin na'urar kai tsaye - kamar kyamara, GPS, ko sanarwa (notifications) - wanda ke sa su iya bayar da gogewa mafi kyau ga mai amfani fiye da shafin yanar gizo na yau da kullum a wasu lokuta.

quiz.question: Menene Mobile App Development?
options: Aikin gina software da ke gudana a wayar hannu ko tablet
quiz.explanation: Mobile App Development yana mai da hankali kan gina apps don wayoyi da tablets.

quiz.question: Ta ina ake sauke apps na wayar hannu galibi?
options: Google Play Store ko Apple App Store
quiz.explanation: Wadannan shagunan biyu sune manyan hanyoyin sauke apps na wayar hannu.

quiz.question: Wanne fasali ne apps na wayar hannu ke iya amfani dashi kai tsaye?
quiz.explanation: Apps na wayar hannu suna da damar amfani da kayan aikin na'urar kai tsaye.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na app na wayar hannu?
quiz.explanation: WhatsApp misali ne sananne na mobile app.

quiz.question: Me ke sa apps na wayar hannu su bambanta da shafukan yanar gizo na yau da kullum?
options: Ana sauke su daga shago kuma suna amfani da fasalolin na'urar kai tsaye
Suna aiki ne kawai a kwamfuta
Ba sa amfani da intanet kwata-kwata
quiz.explanation: Wannan shine babban bambancin da ke tsakanin apps na wayar hannu da shafukan yanar gizo.

diagram.caption: Ma'anar gina apps na wayar hannu

lessons.title: Android vs iOS
lessons.summary: Bambancin manyan tsarurrukan wayar hannu guda biyu
lessons.content:
Android da iOS su ne manyan tsarurrukan aiki (operating systems) guda biyu na wayar hannu a duniya. Android, wanda Google ta kirkira, yana gudana akan wayoyi daga kamfanoni da yawa (Samsung, Tecno, Infinix), yayin da iOS, wanda Apple ta kirkira, yana gudana ne kawai akan wayoyin iPhone.

Gina app don Android galibi ana amfani da Kotlin ko Java, yayin da don iOS ake amfani da Swift. Kowanne tsari yana da nasa shago (Play Store da App Store) da kuma ka'idojinsa na musamman wajen bugawa da amincewa da apps.

quiz.question: Wanne kamfani ne ya kirkiri Android?
quiz.explanation: Google ce ta kirkiri tsarin Android.

quiz.question: Wanne kamfani ne ya kirkiri iOS?
quiz.explanation: Apple ce ta kirkiri tsarin iOS.

quiz.question: A wanne wayoyi ne iOS ke gudana?
quiz.explanation: iOS na Apple ne kadai, don haka yana gudana akan iPhone kadai.

quiz.question: Wanne yare ne ake amfani da shi wajen gina apps na Android?
quiz.explanation: Kotlin da Java sune manyan yarukan da ake amfani dasu don Android.

quiz.question: Wanne yare ne ake amfani da shi wajen gina apps na iOS?
quiz.explanation: Swift shine yaren da Apple ta gina musamman don iOS.

diagram.caption: Bambancin manyan tsarurrukan wayar hannu guda biyu

lessons.title: Native vs Cross-Platform Development
lessons.summary: Hanyoyin gina app don na'urori daban-daban
lessons.content:
Native Development yana nufin gina app na musamman don tsari ɗaya kacal (Android ko iOS), ta amfani da yarukan da suka dace da wancan tsari (Kotlin don Android, Swift don iOS). Wannan yana bayar da mafi kyawun aiki (performance) domin app din yana amfani da kayan aikin na'ura kai tsaye.

Cross-Platform Development kuma yana bada damar rubuta code guda ɗaya wanda zai iya gudana akan Android da iOS duka biyu, ta amfani da fasahohi kamar Flutter ko React Native. Wannan yana rage lokaci da kuɗin haɓaka domin ba a bukatar gina apps guda biyu daban-daban.

quiz.question: Menene Native Development?
options: Gina app na musamman don tsari ɗaya kacal
Gina app wanda ke aiki a dukkan tsarurruka
quiz.explanation: Native yana bukatar gina app daban ga kowane tsari (Android/iOS).

quiz.question: Menene Cross-Platform Development?
options: Rubuta code guda ɗaya wanda zai iya gudana a Android da iOS duka
quiz.explanation: Cross-platform yana bada damar amfani da code guda ɗaya a dukkan tsarurruka.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce Native Development ke bayarwa?
options: Mafi kyawun aiki (performance) domin amfani da kayan aikin na'ura kai tsaye
quiz.explanation: Native apps galibi suna da sauri da inganci fiye da cross-platform saboda kusanci da na'ura.

quiz.question: Wanne fasaha ne misali na Cross-Platform Development?
quiz.explanation: Flutter da React Native sanannun fasahohi ne na cross-platform.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce Cross-Platform ke bayarwa ga kamfani?
options: Rage lokaci da kuɗin haɓaka domin ba a bukatar apps guda biyu daban
quiz.explanation: Rubuta code ɗaya maimakon biyu yana rage kuɗi da lokaci.

diagram.caption: Hanyoyin gina app don na'urori daban-daban

lessons.title: UI/UX na Asali ga Wayar Hannu
lessons.summary: Tsara kamanni da gogewar app mai kyau
lessons.content:
UI (User Interface) yana nufin kamannin app - launi, maballi, da tsari na abubuwa a shafi. UX (User Experience) kuma yana nufin yadda mai amfani ke ji da kuma sauki wajen amfani da app din gaba ɗaya - misali, shin sauki ne a same abin da ake nema ba tare da rudani ba?

Ga wayar hannu, ana bukatar mai da hankali kan girman allo karami - maballi da rubutu ya kamata su isasshe girma domin a iya taɓawa cikin sauki da yatsa. Haka kuma, ana bukatar tunanin yadda za a sarrafa sarari mai iyaka a shafi ba tare da cika shi da abubuwa da yawa ba.

quiz.question: Menene UI (User Interface)?
options: Kamannin app - launi, maballi, da tsarin abubuwa
Yadda mai amfani ke ji gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: UI tana mai da hankali kan kamannin gani na app.

quiz.question: Menene UX (User Experience)?
options: Yadda mai amfani ke ji da sauki wajen amfani da app gaba ɗaya
quiz.explanation: UX tana mai da hankali kan gamsuwar mai amfani gaba ɗaya.

quiz.question: Me yasa maballi ya kamata ya kasance babba a app na wayar hannu?
options: Domin a iya taɓawa cikin sauki da yatsa akan karamin allo
Domin yana da kyan gani kawai
quiz.explanation: Girman allo karami na wayar hannu yana bukatar maballi masu isasshen girma don taɓawa.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata a guji yi da sarari mai iyaka na wayar hannu?
options: Cika shi da abubuwa da yawa
Amfani da shi yadda ya kamata
Bar shi babu komai gaba ɗaya
Babu abin da za a guji
quiz.explanation: Cika sarari da abubuwa da yawa na iya rikita mai amfani a karamin allo.

quiz.question: Wace tambaya ce UX ke amsawa?
options: Shin sauki ne a same abin da ake nema ba tare da rudani ba?
Wane launi ne ya fi kyau kawai?
Nawa app din take da tsada?
quiz.explanation: UX tana mai da hankali kan sauki da gogewar mai amfani gaba ɗaya.

diagram.caption: Tsara kamanni da gogewar app mai kyau

lessons.title: Kayan Aikin Farko (Android Studio, Xcode)
lessons.summary: Software da ake amfani da su wajen gina apps
lessons.content:
Android Studio shine kayan aiki na hukuma da Google ta kirkira domin gina apps na Android, wanda ke dauke da editan code, na'ura mai kwaikwayon waya (emulator) domin gwada app din ba tare da waya ta ainihi ba, da kuma kayan aikin bincike matsala (debugging).

Xcode kuma shine kayan aiki na hukuma da Apple ta kirkira domin gina apps na iOS, wanda ke gudana ne kawai a kwamfutocin Mac. Dukkan biyu suna kyauta a sauke, wanda ke sa mafarin koyon mobile development ya zama mai sauki ga kowa da kowa.

quiz.question: Menene Android Studio?
options: Kayan aiki na hukuma da Google ta kirkira domin gina apps na Android
quiz.explanation: Android Studio kayan aiki ne na asali na gina apps na Android.

quiz.question: Menene Xcode?
options: Kayan aiki na hukuma da Apple ta kirkira domin gina apps na iOS
quiz.explanation: Xcode kayan aiki ne na asali na gina apps na iOS.

quiz.question: A wanne kwamfuta ne Xcode ke gudana?
quiz.explanation: Xcode na Apple ne, don haka yana gudana ne kawai akan Mac.

quiz.question: Menene emulator a Android Studio ke bayarwa?
options: Na'ura mai kwaikwayon waya domin gwada app ba tare da waya ta ainihi ba
quiz.explanation: Emulator yana bada damar gwada app a kwamfuta kafin amfani da waya ta gaske.

quiz.question: Shin Android Studio da Xcode suna da tsada wajen sauke su?
quiz.explanation: Duka Android Studio da Xcode kyauta ne, wanda ke sauƙaƙa fara koyo.

diagram.caption: Software da ake amfani da su wajen gina apps

lessons.title: Gina App na Farko Mai Sauki
lessons.summary: Matakan farko na aikace-aikacen gina app
lessons.content:
Don gina app na farko mai sauki, misali app na 'Sannu Duniya' (Hello World), za a fara da kirkirar sabon 'project' a Android Studio ko Xcode, sannan a rubuta kadan code domin nuna rubutu a allo lokacin da app din ya bude. Wannan aiki mai sauki yana bada damar fahimtar tsarin gaba ɗaya na yadda ake gina app, kafin a fara kara sarkakiya.

Bayan wannan, mataki na gaba shine koyon yadda ake amfani da maballi (buttons), fom (forms), da kuma yadda ake sauya daga shafi zuwa wani a cikin app din. Fara da sauki sannan a kara sarkakiya a hankali shine mafi kyawun tafarki ga sabon dan koyo.

quiz.question: Menene aikin farko da ake ba da shawara ga sabon dan koyon mobile development?
options: App mai sarkakiya sosai kai tsaye
quiz.explanation: Hello World app ce mai sauki wadda ake amfani da ita wajen koyon asali.

quiz.question: Me ake bukata don fara aiki a Android Studio ko Xcode?
quiz.explanation: Kowane app yana farawa da kirkirar sabon project a kayan aikin da aka zaba.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce aikin 'Hello World' ke bayarwa?
options: Bada damar fahimtar tsarin gaba ɗaya kafin a kara sarkakiya
quiz.explanation: Hello World yana taimaka wa sabon dan koyo fahimtar asalin tsari ba tare da rudani ba.

quiz.question: Wanne mataki ne bayan Hello World?
options: Koyon amfani da maballi da fom
quiz.explanation: Bayan asali, ana koyon fasalolin mu'amala kamar maballi da fom.

quiz.question: Wace hikima ce mafi kyau ga sabon dan koyo?
options: Fara da sauki sannan a kara sarkakiya a hankali
Fara da mafi wahala kai tsaye
quiz.explanation: Wannan tafarki yana taimaka wa sabon dan koyo gina tushe mai ƙarfi.

diagram.caption: Matakan farko na aikace-aikacen gina app

lessons.title: Flutter da React Native
lessons.summary: Zurfin bayani kan manyan cross-platform frameworks
lessons.content:
Flutter, wanda Google ta kirkira, yana amfani da yaren Dart, kuma yana zana kowane bangare na app din da kansa (custom rendering), wanda ke bada damar app dinsa ya yi kama iri ɗaya a Android da iOS. React Native kuma, wanda Facebook ta kirkira, yana amfani da JavaScript kuma yana amfani da fasalolin 'native' na asali na kowane tsari, wanda ke sa app dinsa ya yi kama da app na asali fiye da Flutter wani lokaci.

Zabi tsakanin su biyu ya dogara ne akan bukatar aikin - Flutter ta fi dacewa idan kana son cikakken iko akan kyan gani, yayin da React Native ta fi dacewa idan timinka na da gogewa a JavaScript tuni.

quiz.question: Wanne yare ne Flutter ke amfani da shi?
quiz.explanation: Flutter yana amfani da yaren Dart wanda Google ta gina.

quiz.question: Wanne yare ne React Native ke amfani da shi?
quiz.explanation: React Native yana amfani da JavaScript.

quiz.question: Wanne kamfani ne ya kirkiri Flutter?
quiz.explanation: Google ce ta kirkiri Flutter.

quiz.question: Wanne kamfani ne ya kirkiri React Native?
quiz.explanation: Facebook (yanzu Meta) ta kirkiri React Native.

quiz.question: Yaushe React Native ta fi dacewa a matsayin zabi?
options: Idan timin ka na da gogewa a JavaScript tuni
Idan kake son kyan gani na musamman kadai
quiz.explanation: React Native tana da amfani musamman idan timin ka ya riga ya san JavaScript.

diagram.caption: Zurfin bayani kan manyan cross-platform frameworks

lessons.title: Ajiyar Bayanai a App (Local Storage)
lessons.summary: Yadda apps ke ajiye bayanai a na'urar mai amfani
lessons.content:
Apps na iya bukatar ajiye bayanai a wayar kanta domin amfani na gaba, ko da babu intanet. Ana amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban bisa girman bayanai: 'SharedPreferences' (Android) ko 'UserDefaults' (iOS) don karamin bayani kamar saitunan mai amfani, da kuma database na cikin gida kamar SQLite ko Room domin bayanai masu tsari da yawa.

Ajiyar bayanai a cikin gida (local storage) yana da amfani domin app din ya iya aiki koda babu intanet (offline mode), sannan ya sabunta bayanan zuwa server lokacin da intanet ya dawo, wani tsari da ake kira 'offline-first' design.

quiz.question: Menene SharedPreferences a Android ke ajiyewa?
options: Karamin bayani kamar saitunan mai amfani
quiz.explanation: SharedPreferences ta dace da karamin bayani, ba manyan bayanai masu tsari ba.

quiz.question: Wanne database ne ake amfani dashi wajen ajiya na cikin gida mai tsari?
quiz.explanation: SQLite/Room sune manyan zabuka don ajiyar bayanai masu tsari a cikin app.

quiz.question: Me ake kira ajiyar bayanai a wayar UserDefaults a iOS?
quiz.explanation: UserDefaults ita ce dabarar iOS ta ajiyar karamin bayani, kwatankwacin SharedPreferences a Android.

quiz.question: Menene 'offline-first' design?
options: Tsara app ya yi aiki koda babu intanet sannan ya sabunta lokacin da intanet ya dawo
Tsara app wanda ke bukatar intanet koyaushe
quiz.explanation: Offline-first yana tabbatar da app na aiki ko da babu intanet.

quiz.question: Me yasa ajiyar bayanai a cikin gida ke da amfani?
options: Domin app din ya iya aiki koda babu intanet
quiz.explanation: Local storage yana tabbatar da app na iya aiki hatta ba tare da intanet ba.

diagram.caption: Yadda apps ke ajiye bayanai a na'urar mai amfani

lessons.title: APIs da Backend Integration a Mobile
lessons.summary: Yadda apps ke sadarwa da bayanan da ke bayan fage
lessons.content:
Yawancin apps na wayar hannu suna bukatar bayanai daga wani backend server - misali, app na sayarwa yana bukatar samun jerin kayayyaki daga database mai nisa. App din yana amfani da REST API domin aika bukata zuwa server, sannan ya karba amsa (galibi a tsarin JSON) domin nunawa ga mai amfani.

Ana bukatar sarrafa hakuri (loading states) yayin da app din ke jira amsa daga server, da kuma tsara yadda za a nuna kuskure idan intanet bai yi aiki ba ko server ya ƙasa amsawa - wannan yana da matukar muhimmanci wajen bada gogewa mai kyau ga mai amfani.

quiz.question: Ta yaya app na sayarwa ke samun jerin kayayyaki?
options: Ta hanyar aika bukata zuwa backend server ta amfani da REST API
quiz.explanation: Apps na amfani da APIs domin samun bayanai daga backend.

quiz.question: Wanne tsari ne galibi ake amfani da shi wajen amsar API?
quiz.explanation: JSON tsari ne mai sauki karantawa da ake amfani da shi wajen musayar bayanai.

quiz.question: Me ake bukatar sarrafawa yayin da app ke jira amsa daga server?
quiz.explanation: Loading states suna nuna wa mai amfani cewa app din yana aiki a bango.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata a yi idan intanet bai yi aiki ba lokacin da app ke bukatar bayanai?
options: Nuna kuskure ga mai amfani cikin sauki gani
Rufe app din ba tare da bayani ba
quiz.explanation: Sanar da mai amfani game da matsalar intanet yana bada gogewa mafi kyau.

quiz.question: Me yasa sarrafa kuskure yayin bukatar API ke da muhimmanci?
options: Yana bada gogewa mai kyau ga mai amfani ko da wata matsala ta faru
quiz.explanation: Sarrafa kuskure yadda ya kamata yana tabbatar mai amfani baya rudewa idan wata matsala ta taso.

lessons.title: Gwaji da Debugging na Mobile Apps
lessons.summary: Yadda ake tabbatar da app yana aiki daidai
lessons.content:
Gwajin mobile apps yana da wasu kalubale na musamman fiye da gwajin web apps, domin akwai wayoyi masu girma daban-daban, tsarin aiki (Android/iOS) daban-daban, da sigogi daban-daban na tsarin aiki. Ana bukatar gwada app din a na'urori na ainihi (real devices) baya ga emulators, domin wasu matsaloli suna bayyana ne kawai a wayar ta ainihi.

Kayan aiki kamar Firebase Test Lab suna bada damar gwada app din akan wayoyi da yawa daban-daban ta atomatik, wanda ke sauƙaƙa gano matsalolin da za su iya bayyana a wasu na'urori kawai amma ba a wasu ba.

quiz.question: Me yasa gwajin mobile apps ke da wasu kalubale na musamman?
options: Domin akwai wayoyi masu girma da tsarin aiki daban-daban
Domin apps na wayar hannu basu bukatar gwaji
quiz.explanation: Bambancin na'urori da sigogi na tsarin aiki yana kawo kalubale na musamman.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar gwada app a na'urori na ainihi baya ga emulators?
options: Domin wasu matsaloli suna bayyana ne kawai a wayar ta ainihi
Domin emulators sun fi kyau koyaushe
Babu bukatar gwada wayar ta ainihi
quiz.explanation: Wasu matsaloli (kamar na baturi ko sensor) basa bayyana a emulator.

quiz.question: Menene Firebase Test Lab ke bayarwa?
options: Gwada app akan wayoyi da yawa daban-daban ta atomatik
quiz.explanation: Firebase Test Lab yana sauƙaƙa gwada app akan na'urori masu bambanci.

quiz.question: Wanne bambanci ne ke kawo kalubale ga gwajin mobile apps?
options: Girman wayoyi da sigogin tsarin aiki daban-daban
quiz.explanation: Wadannan bambance-bambance suna kara wahalar tabbatar da app na aiki daidai a ko'ina.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata a yi domin gano matsalolin da ke bayyana a wasu na'urori kadai?
options: Gwada app a na'urori da yawa daban-daban
Gwada app a na'ura ɗaya kadai
quiz.explanation: Gwada a na'urori masu bambanci yana taimaka wa gano matsalolin da ba a iya gani ba a wuri guda kadai.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake tabbatar da app yana aiki daidai

lessons.title: Buga App a Google Play/App Store
lessons.summary: Matakan da ake bi kafin jama'a su sami damar sauke app
lessons.content:
Kafin buga app a Google Play Store, ana bukatar kirkirar asusun developer (wanda ke bukatar biyan karamin kuɗi sau ɗaya kacal), sannan a shirya bayanai kamar bayanin app din, hotuna, da manufofin sirri (privacy policy). Google zai bincika app din kafin ya buga shi ga jama'a, kodayake wannan tsari galibi ba ya dauke lokaci mai tsawo idan aka kwatanta da Apple.

Apple App Store yana da tsari mafi tsauri na bincike (review), wanda zai iya dauke kwanaki da yawa, kuma Apple na iya kin amincewa da app idan bai bi ka'idojinsu ba. Fahimtar wadannan bambance-bambance yana taimaka wa mai gina app tsara lokacin da ake tsammani don kaddamar da app din.

quiz.question: Me ake bukata kafin buga app a Google Play Store?
options: Kirkirar asusun developer da biyan karamin kuɗi sau ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Asusun developer da karamin kuɗi na dole kafin buga app a Play Store.

quiz.question: Wanne shago ne ya fi tsauri wajen bincike (review)?
options: Babu wani bincike da ake yi
quiz.explanation: Apple na da tsari mai tsauri na bincike wanda zai iya dauke kwanaki.

quiz.question: Wanne bayani ne ake bukata a shirya kafin buga app?
options: Bayanin app, hotuna, da manufofin sirri
Babu wani bayani da ake bukata
quiz.explanation: Wadannan bayanai suna bada damar masu amfani su fahimci app din kafin sauke shi.

quiz.question: Me zai iya faruwa idan app bai bi ka'idojin Apple ba?
options: Apple na iya kin amincewa da app
Za a buga app din nan take
quiz.explanation: Apple na iya ki amincewa idan app bai bi ka'idojinsu ba.

quiz.question: Me yasa ya kamata a fahimci bambancin lokutan bincike na shagunan biyu?
options: Domin tsara lokacin da ake tsammani don kaddamar da app
quiz.explanation: Sanin wannan bambanci yana taimaka wa mai gina app shirya jadawalin kaddamarwa.

diagram.caption: Matakan da ake bi kafin jama'a su sami damar sauke app

lessons.title: Monetization - Samun Kuɗi Daga App
lessons.summary: Hanyoyin samun kuɗi daga app na wayar hannu
lessons.content:
Akwai hanyoyi da yawa na samun kuɗi daga app: Talla (ads) yana bawa app damar zama kyauta ga masu amfani yayin da ake samun kuɗi daga kamfanonin da ke son yin tallace-tallace; In-App Purchases yana bada damar sayan abubuwa a cikin app (kamar sabbin fasaloli ko kayan wasa); Subscription kuma yana bukatar biyan kuɗi na wata-wata don ci gaba da amfani da wasu fasaloli.

Zaɓan hanyar da ta fi dacewa ya dogara da irin app din da kake gina - misali, app na kayan aiki na yau da kullum wanda ake amfani da shi na dogon lokaci ya fi dacewa da subscription, yayin da app na wasa mai sauki zai iya amfana daga talla da in-app purchases.

quiz.question: Menene 'In-App Purchases'?
options: Sayan abubuwa a cikin app kamar sabbin fasaloli
Sayen app din da kansa kadai
quiz.explanation: In-App Purchases suna bada damar sayan abubuwa a cikin app bayan an sauke shi.

quiz.question: Menene Subscription a matsayin hanyar samun kuɗi?
options: Biyan kuɗi na wata-wata don ci gaba da amfani da wasu fasaloli
quiz.explanation: Subscription yana bukatar biya akai-akai (misali kowace wata) don ci gaba da fasaloli.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce talla (ads) ke bayarwa ga masu amfani?
options: App din ya zama kyauta ga masu amfani
Suna rasa dama amfani da app
quiz.explanation: Talla yana bada damar app ya zama kyauta ga mai amfani, yayin da kamfanoni ke biyan kuɗi don talla.

quiz.question: Wanne app ne ya fi dacewa da subscription?
options: App na kayan aiki na yau da kullum wanda ake amfani da shi na dogon lokaci
App mai sauki mai amfani sau ɗaya kadai
Babu wani app da ya dace
App na wasa mai sauki kadai
quiz.explanation: Subscription ta fi dacewa da apps da ake amfani dasu akai-akai na dogon lokaci.

quiz.question: Wace hanyar samun kuɗi za ta iya dacewa da app na wasa mai sauki?
options: Biyan kuɗi mai tsada sau ɗaya kadai
quiz.explanation: Apps na wasa masu sauki galibi suna amfana da talla da siyayya na cikin app.

diagram.caption: Hanyoyin samun kuɗi daga app na wayar hannu

lessons.title: Push Notifications da Background Services
lessons.summary: Yadda apps ke aiki ko da ba a bude su ba
lessons.content:
Push Notifications suna bada damar server ya aika sako zuwa wayar mai amfani ko da app din ba a bude yake ba, misali sanarwar sabon sako a WhatsApp. Wannan yana amfani da tsari na musamman - Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) don Android, da Apple Push Notification service (APNs) don iOS.

Background Services kuma suna bada damar app ya ci gaba da aiki a bango, misali sabunta wurin da mai amfani yake (location) don app na taxi. Ana bukatar sarrafa wadannan da hankali domin kada su cinye baturin waya da yawa, kuma tsarurrukan aiki na yau da kullum suna da ka'idoji masu tsauri kan yadda apps za su iya amfani da background services.

quiz.question: Menene Push Notifications ke bada damar yi?
options: Server ya aika sako zuwa wayar mai amfani ko da app ba a bude yake ba
quiz.explanation: Push notifications suna aiki ko da app din ba a bude yake ba a wancan lokaci.

quiz.question: Wanne tsari ne ake amfani da shi don push notifications a Android?
quiz.explanation: FCM shine tsari da ake amfani dashi don push notifications a Android.

quiz.question: Wanne tsari ne ake amfani da shi don push notifications a iOS?
quiz.explanation: APNs shine tsari na Apple don push notifications a iOS.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na Background Service?
options: Sabunta wurin da mai amfani yake don app na taxi
quiz.explanation: Wannan misali ne na app da ke aiki a bango koda ba a bude shi kai tsaye ba.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar sarrafa background services da hankali?
options: Domin kada su cinye baturin waya da yawa
Domin dole ne bisa doka kadai
quiz.explanation: Yawan amfani da background services ba tare da kula ba na iya cinye baturi da yawa.

diagram.caption: Yadda apps ke aiki ko da ba a bude su ba

lessons.title: Tsaron App na Wayar Hannu
lessons.summary: Matakan kariya na musamman ga mobile apps
lessons.content:
Tsaron mobile apps ya kunshi matakai kamar ɓoye bayanai masu muhimmanci (kamar API keys) don kada masu kutse su same su ta hanyar duba code din app din bayan an sauke shi. Ana kuma bukatar amfani da HTTPS koyaushe wajen sadarwa da backend, domin kare bayanan da ake tura tsakanin app da server daga leken asiri.

Haka kuma, ana bada shawarar amfani da 'certificate pinning' wanda ke tabbatar da app din yana magana ne kai tsaye da ainihin server din da ya kamata, ba wani mai kutse wanda ke kwaikwayon server din ba (man-in-the-middle attack). Wadannan matakai suna da matukar muhimmanci musamman ga apps na banki ko wadanda ke rike da bayanan sirri.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar ɓoye API keys a cikin app?
options: Domin kada masu kutse su same su ta hanyar duba code na app
Domin dole ne bisa doka kadai
quiz.explanation: API keys da ba a ɓoye su ba na iya bayyana ga masu kutse.

quiz.question: Me yasa ake bukatar amfani da HTTPS koyaushe a mobile apps?
options: Domin kare bayanan da ake tura tsakanin app da server daga leken asiri
Domin dole ne bisa doka kadai
quiz.explanation: HTTPS yana kare bayanan da ke tafiya tsakanin app da server.

quiz.question: Menene 'certificate pinning'?
options: Tabbatar da app yana magana ne kai tsaye da ainihin server din da ya kamata
quiz.explanation: Certificate pinning yana kariya daga hare-haren man-in-the-middle.

quiz.question: Menene 'man-in-the-middle attack'?
options: Mai kutse wanda ke kwaikwayon server din da app din ke magana da shi
quiz.explanation: Wannan hari yana bada damar mai kutse ya sa ido ko canza sadarwar tsakanin app da server.

quiz.question: Wanne app ne ya fi bukatar matakan tsaro masu zurfi kamar certificate pinning?
options: Apps na banki ko wadanda ke rike da bayanan sirri
App na wasa mai sauki kadai
Babu wani app da ya bukaci wannan
quiz.explanation: Apps masu bayanan sirri masu muhimmanci suna bukatar mafi tsauri matakan tsaro.

diagram.caption: Matakan kariya na musamman ga mobile apps

lessons.title: Performance Optimization ga Mobile Apps
lessons.summary: Yadda ake sa app ya yi sauri kuma ya rage cinye baturi
lessons.content:
Performance Optimization a mobile ya kunshi dabaru kamar: rage girman hotuna kafin sanya su a app, amfani da 'lazy loading' don loda abubuwa kawai lokacin da ake bukatarsu, da kuma rage yawan bukatun network da app din ke yi. Wadannan dabaru suna sa app ya yi sauri kuma ya cinye karancin bayanan intanet (data) na mai amfani.

Haka kuma, ana bukatar kula da yadda app din ke amfani da baturi - misali, guje wa yin amfani da GPS ko sensor koyaushe idan ba a bukatarsu ba, domin wadannan fasaloli suna cinye baturi da yawa. Kayan aiki kamar Android Profiler suna taimaka wa masu haɓaka gano wadanne bangarori ne ke cinye albarkatun na'ura da yawa.

quiz.question: Wace dabara ce za ta iya sa app ya yi sauri?
options: Rage girman hotuna kafin sanya su a app
quiz.explanation: Hotuna masu karancin girma suna loda cikin sauri.

quiz.question: Menene 'lazy loading' a mobile apps?
options: Loda abubuwa kawai lokacin da ake bukatarsu
Loda dukkan abubuwa nan take koyaushe
quiz.explanation: Lazy loading yana rage lodawa mara bukata nan take.

quiz.question: Me ya kamata a guji yi domin kada a cinye baturi da yawa?
options: Amfani da GPS ko sensor koyaushe ba dalili
Amfani da app din sau ɗaya kadai
Babu abin da za a guji
quiz.explanation: GPS da sensors na iya cinye baturi da yawa idan ana amfani dasu ba dalili.

quiz.question: Menene Android Profiler ke bayarwa?
options: Taimaka wa masu haɓaka gano wadanne bangarori ne ke cinye albarkatu da yawa
quiz.explanation: Android Profiler kayan aiki ne na bincika aikin app da amfaninsa na albarkatu.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce rage bukatun network ke bayarwa?
options: Sa app ya yi sauri kuma ya rage cinye bayanan intanet na mai amfani
quiz.explanation: Rage bukatun network yana rage yawan bayanan intanet da mai amfani ke kashewa.

diagram.caption: Yadda ake sa app ya yi sauri kuma ya rage cinye baturi

lessons.title: CI/CD don Mobile Development
lessons.summary: Atomatik gina da gwada apps kafin buga su
lessons.content:
Kamar yadda aka koya a darasin cloud computing, CI/CD tana atomatik gina da gwada code duk lokacin da injiniya ya kara canji. A mobile development, wannan yana da amfani sosai domin gina app na Android ko iOS na iya dauke lokaci, kuma ana bukatar gwada shi akan na'urori daban-daban kafin a buga shi.

Kayan aiki kamar Fastlane suna sauƙaƙa aikin CI/CD na musamman ga mobile apps, ta hanyar atomatik gina app din, gudanar da tests, da kuma sanya app din zuwa Google Play ko App Store, wanda ke rage aikin da injiniyoyi ke bukatar yi da hannu kafin kowace sabuntawa.

quiz.question: Me CI/CD ke yi duk lokacin da injiniya ya kara canji a mobile app?
options: Yana atomatik gina da gwada code din
quiz.explanation: CI/CD yana atomatik gina da gwada sabon canji da aka kara.

quiz.question: Me yasa CI/CD ke da amfani sosai a mobile development?
options: Domin gina app na iya dauke lokaci kuma ana bukatar gwadawa akan na'urori daban-daban
quiz.explanation: Mobile apps na bukatar gina da gwaji akan na'urori masu bambanci, wanda CI/CD ke sauƙaƙawa.

quiz.question: Wanne kayan aiki ne aka gina musamman don CI/CD na mobile?
options: Babu wani kayan aiki na musamman
quiz.explanation: Fastlane kayan aiki ne sananne na CI/CD na musamman ga mobile apps.

quiz.question: Me Fastlane zai iya yi ta atomatik?
options: Gina app, gudanar da tests, da sanya app zuwa Play Store/App Store
Babu abin da yake iya yi ta atomatik
quiz.explanation: Fastlane yana atomatik dukkan wadannan matakai na deployment.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce CI/CD ke bayarwa ga injiniyoyin mobile?
options: Rage aikin da ake bukatar yi da hannu kafin kowace sabuntawa
Kara aikin da ake yi da hannu
quiz.explanation: Automation yana sauƙaƙa aikin injiniyoyi wajen sakin sabbin sigogi.

lessons.title: Wearables da IoT Integration
lessons.summary: Hade apps da na'urori kamar agogon hannu
lessons.content:
Wearables (kamar Apple Watch ko Wear OS) da na'urorin IoT (Internet of Things, kamar firji mai wayo ko na'urar auna zuciya) suna bada sabuwar dama ga masu gina apps na wayar hannu su hada da wadannan na'urori. Misali, wani app na motsa jiki zai iya karban bayanan bugun zuciya kai tsaye daga agogon hannu, ya nuna su ga mai amfani a wayarsa.

Hada app da wearables/IoT yana bukatar fahimtar musamman fasahar sadarwa kamar Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), wadda ke bada damar na'urori masu karancin baturi (kamar sensor) su sadar da wayar hannu ba tare da cinye baturi da yawa ba.

quiz.question: Menene Wearables?
options: Na'urori kamar Apple Watch ko Wear OS da za a sanya a jiki
quiz.explanation: Wearables na'urori ne masu sawa a jiki kamar agogon hannu.

quiz.question: Menene IoT (Internet of Things)?
options: Na'urori kamar firji mai wayo da ke hade da intanet
quiz.explanation: IoT yana bayyana na'urori masu hade da intanet baya ga kwamfuta da waya.

quiz.question: Wanne misali ne na amfani da wearables a app?
options: App na motsa jiki yana karban bugun zuciya daga agogon hannu
quiz.explanation: Wannan misali ne mai sauki na yadda apps ke hade da wearables.

quiz.question: Wace fasaha ce ake amfani da ita don sadarwa da na'urori masu karancin baturi?
quiz.explanation: BLE tana bada damar sadarwa ba tare da cinye baturi da yawa ba.

quiz.question: Me yasa BLE ke da amfani ga na'urorin IoT/wearables?
options: Domin ba ta cinye baturi da yawa yayin sadarwa
Domin tana cinye baturi da yawa
quiz.explanation: Karancin cinyewar baturi yana da muhimmanci ga karamin na'urorin da ke da baturi kadan.

diagram.caption: Hade apps da na'urori kamar agogon hannu

lessons.title: Sana'o'i a Fannin Mobile Development
lessons.summary: Hanyoyin fara sana'a a fannin gina apps na wayar hannu
lessons.content:
Akwai sana'o'i da yawa a fannin mobile: 'Android Developer' yana mai da hankali kan gina apps na Android, 'iOS Developer' yana mai da hankali kan iOS, kuma 'Mobile Engineer' na iya nufin wanda ke amfani da cross-platform frameworks domin gina apps ga dukkan tsarurruka biyu.

Don fara wannan tafarki, ana ba da shawarar zaɓan hanya ɗaya (Native Android/iOS ko Cross-Platform) a koya sosai, sannan a buga wani app mai sauki na kansa a Google Play ko App Store domin samun gogewa ta ainihi kan dukkan tsarin - daga rubuta code zuwa buga app din ga jama'a.

quiz.question: Menene aikin Android Developer?
options: Mai da hankali kan gina apps na Android
Mai da hankali kan iOS kadai
quiz.explanation: Android Developer yana mai da hankali kan gina apps don tsarin Android.

quiz.question: Menene aikin iOS Developer?
options: Mai da hankali kan gina apps na iOS
Mai da hankali kan Android kadai
quiz.explanation: iOS Developer yana mai da hankali kan gina apps don na'urorin Apple.

quiz.question: Menene ake nufi da Mobile Engineer wanda ke amfani da cross-platform?
options: Yana gina apps ga dukkan tsarurruka biyu ta amfani da code guda ɗaya
quiz.explanation: Wannan rawar tana amfani da fasahohi kamar Flutter/React Native don dukkan tsarurruka.

quiz.question: Me ake ba da shawara a matsayin mataki na farko don shiga fannin mobile?
options: Zaɓan hanya ɗaya (Native ko Cross-Platform) a koya sosai
Koyon dukkan hanyoyi a lokaci ɗaya
Jira har a gama koyon komai
quiz.explanation: Zaɓan hanya ɗaya yana bada tushe mai ƙarfi kafin fadada zuwa wasu.

quiz.question: Wace fa'ida ce buga wani app na kansa ke bayarwa ga mai koyo?
options: Samun gogewa ta ainihi daga rubuta code zuwa buga app ga jama'a
quiz.explanation: Wannan gogewa tana koya wa mutum dukkan matakan aiki, ba kawai rubuta code ba.
